result.summary: The image depicts a wide, multi-lane urban thoroughfare flanked by high-rise commercial buildings. While basic pedestrian infrastructure like sidewalks and signalized crossings are present, the significant crossing distance and lack of mid-street refuge islands increase pedestrian exposure to high-volume traffic.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must traverse a very wide roadway with at least four travel lanes, increasing their time spent in the path of vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: The main intersection crossing in the mid-ground.

hazards.name: Multi-lane Threat
hazards.description: The presence of multiple lanes of vehicles can create scenarios where one car stops for a pedestrian but obscures them from drivers in adjacent lanes.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the multiple travel lanes in the center of the image.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island at the crossing to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time and provide a safe waiting area.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at the intersection corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines between pedestrians and motorists.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program traffic signals to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before the parallel vehicle traffic gets a green light.

result.summary: The image shows a high-quality pedestrian plaza separated from a multi-lane urban roadway by a line of bollards and large planters. While the pedestrian space itself is well-protected, the adjacent roadway is wide, suggesting a significant crossing distance and potential for high-volume traffic.

hazards.name: Wide Roadway
hazards.description: The multi-lane configuration creates a long, unprotected crossing distance for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Vehicle Proximity
hazards.description: High-volume traffic lanes are immediately adjacent to the pedestrian plaza.

result.summary: The image shows a wide, multi-lane urban corridor with significant building density and wide sidewalks. While pedestrians are well-separated from traffic on the sidewalks, the lack of immediate crossing infrastructure and the wide roadway width create a high-exposure environment for anyone attempting to cross.

hazards.description: The multi-lane roadway requires pedestrians to cover a long distance without the protection of a median or refuge island.

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Vehicles parked along the curb can block sightlines between pedestrians and approaching drivers.

result.summary: This high-density urban environment features heavy vehicular traffic across multiple lanes, creating significant crossing challenges. While wide sidewalks are present, the lack of visible crossing infrastructure and sightline obstructions from large vehicles like buses increase pedestrian risk.

hazards.description: The large SEPTA bus and dense traffic block sightlines between pedestrians on the sidewalk and drivers in adjacent lanes.
